answer: Decentralized agent swarms suppress Sybil entities using acoustic multipath profiling. Beacons broadcast an ultrasonic pulse whose reverberations between a mountain glacier and an adjacent terrace create unique spatial signatures. An attacker cannot emulate these local echoes digitally and must deploy separate physical acoustic sensors per identity, incurring real hardware costs. A key limitation is that rapid wind shifts can distort sonic waveforms, occasionally rejecting honest agents.
